# Legal Writing Experts

> > Professional legal writing, document drafting, and outsourcing services for attorneys, law firms, and law students with expert-led support across litigation, compliance, and academic work.

Legal Writing Experts provides comprehensive legal document drafting, research, review, and outsourcing services staffed by experienced attorneys and paralegals. The platform serves law firms, individual attorneys, and law students with specialized support in civil litigation, criminal motions, contract review, and legal research.

## Core Legal Services

- [We Write All Legal Papers For You](https://legalwritingexperts.com): Homepage showcasing legal writing services including drafting, research, and contract review.
- [Civil Litigation: Expert Legal Document Drafting for Your Case](https://legalwritingexperts.com/civil-litigation): Civil litigation document drafting service for pleadings, motions, discovery, and appeals.
- [Criminal Motion Legal Briefs Services by Experienced Attorneys](https://legalwritingexperts.com/legal-brief-writing-services-for-criminal-motions): Expert criminal motion brief writing for motions to dismiss, discovery, and motions in limine.
- [Legal Document Review Service](https://legalwritingexperts.com/legal-document-review-services): Expert legal document review for contracts, agreements, and filings ensuring compliance.
- [Lawyer Document Review](https://legalwritingexperts.com/lawyer-document-review): Lawyer-led document review for contracts, compliance, and legal analysis.
- [Online Legal Document Review](https://legalwritingexperts.com/online-legal-document-review): Secure online document review with risk assessment and legal compliance evaluation.

## Attorney & Firm Support Services

- [Legal Outsourcing Services](https://legalwritingexperts.com/legal-outsourcing-services): Attorney-supervised legal outsourcing with GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001 compliance.
- [Virtual Legal Assistant for Attorneys](https://legalwritingexperts.com/virtual-legal-assistant): Remote legal assistant providing document drafting, research, and case management support.
- [Paralegal Services: Hire a Paralegal From Trusted Legal Experts](https://legalwritingexperts.com/paralegal-services): Virtual paralegal services for estate planning, bankruptcy, and personal injury support.
- [Legal Letter Writing Services for Hire](https://legalwritingexperts.com/legal-letter-writing-services): Professional legal letter and correspondence drafting for all business needs.

## Legal Writing Resources & Guides

- [Legal Research Memo](https://legalwritingexperts.com/legal-research-memo): Guide to legal research memos with IRAC format, case law analysis, and writing tips.
- [Motion for Extension of Time to File Answer](https://legalwritingexperts.com/legal-brief-writing-services-for-criminal-motions/motion-for-extension-of-time-to-file-answer-2): Guide to filing Motion for Extension of Time under Federal Rules of Civil Procedure Rule 6(b).
- [Motion to withdraw as counsel](https://legalwritingexperts.com/legal-brief-writing-services-for-criminal-motions/motion-to-withdraw-as-counsel): Guide to filing Motion to Withdraw as Counsel under ABA Model Rule 1.16.
- [Motion for Sanctions: Definition, Legal Basis, Types, Filing Procedures, Case Examples](https://legalwritingexperts.com/legal-brief-writing-services-for-criminal-motions/motion-for-sanctions): Comprehensive guide to motions for sanctions under Federal Rules of Civil Procedure Rule 11.
- [Motion to Stay Proceedings: Stay of Proceedings vs Dismissal: Key Differences Explained](https://legalwritingexperts.com/legal-brief-writing-services-for-criminal-motions/motion-to-stay-proceedings): Guide distinguishing motion to stay from dismissal with court standards and filing strategy.
- [Motion to Substitute Counsel: Definition, Court Discretion, Timing, Justification, Procedural Impact, Case Examples](https://legalwritingexperts.com/legal-brief-writing-services-for-criminal-motions/motion-to-substitute-counsel): Guide to Motion to Substitute Counsel with timing, justification, and procedural impact.
